description: This file defines data models for API schemas related to videos and subtitles, utilizing Pydantic for validation and serialization.

classes.name: SubtitleBase
classes.description: Base model for subtitle data, including language code.

classes.name: SubtitleCreate
classes.description: Placeholder class for subtitle creation validation, inherits from SubtitleBase.

classes.name: SubtitleOut
classes.description: Model for subtitle metadata returned to clients, includes additional file info.

classes.name: VideoBase
classes.description: Base model for video data, including title and optional description.

classes.name: VideoCreate
classes.description: Placeholder class for video creation validation, inherits from VideoBase.

classes.name: VideoOut
classes.description: Model for video metadata, includes subtitles and file information.

classes.name: VideoListItem
classes.description: Simplified representation of video data for listing.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Model used for returning error messages.
